meta.name: make-plan
meta.description: Create a detailed, phased implementation plan with documentation discovery. Use when asked to plan a feature, task, or multi-step implementation — especially before executing with do.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将需求拆解为分阶段实施计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在动手前制定详细的分步实施方案。
copy.tagline_en: Break down requirements into phased implementation plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a detailed phased plan before executing a feature or task.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会先派子代理去查证文档里真实存在的 API 和示例、标出可复制的代码位置，再产出一份分阶段的实现计划，每个阶段附文档引用、验证清单和不该做的反模式提示。
howto.when: 当你要求为某个功能、任务或多步实现做规划时触发；原文还建议在配合 do 执行之前，或计划源自 bug 清单时，先走 oh-my-issues。

say.text: 帮我规划给登录页加验证码这个功能
say.note: 会先查文档再分阶段出计划

say.text: 为这个多步任务写份分阶段计划,标注参考文档和验证方法
say.note: 每阶段含文档引用与验证清单

say.text: 这个需求来自一堆 bug,先用 oh-my-issues 整理成设计文档
say.note: 再从设计文档里取一块出计划

howto.what_en: Claude first sends subagents to read docs and confirm real APIs and examples, noting copy-ready code locations, then writes a phased implementation plan with doc references, verification checklists and anti-pattern guards.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to plan a feature, task or multi-step implementation; before executing with do, or when a plan grows out of a bug backlog, the doc suggests routing through oh-my-issues first.

say_en.text: Plan how to add a captcha to the login page.
say_en.note: Docs are checked first, then phased plan.

say_en.text: Write a phased plan for this multi-step task, citing docs and checks.
say_en.note: Each phase lists doc refs and verification.

say_en.text: These requirements come from a bug backlog; cluster them with oh-my-issues first.
say_en.note: Then plan one slice from the design doc.
